$comment: Schema version 1.0.0. The versioning rules are in schema/README.md.
title: Zadrya substance dataset
description: The substance catalog built from PsychonautWiki. This schema checks shape only: cross-field invariants (increasing ranges, min not above max, existing references, symmetric interactions, unique names) are checked by the pipeline.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the schema this document follows. This schema accepts major version 1 only.

datasetVersion.description: Semantic version of the dataset content.

attribution.description: Sources the dataset is derived from, with their licenses. Never empty.

categories.description: Categories a substance can belong to.

interactionGroups.description: Named groups of substances that interaction targets of kind group refer to.

crossToleranceGroups.description: Groups of substances that share tolerance with each other. A substance lists the groups it has cross tolerance with in crossTolerances.

semver.description: A semantic version of the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, without pre-release or build metadata.

text.description: One line of text: not empty, no whitespace at the start or the end, and no control character or line break anywhere.

paragraphs.description: Text of one or more paragraphs separated by line feeds (U+000A): not empty, no whitespace at the start or the end, and no other control character.

slug.description: A lowercase token: letters and digits, with single hyphens between words.

nonNegative.description: A number that is zero or more.

url.description: Address of the source: https only, printable ASCII (anything else percent-encoded).

license.description: License of the source, as an SPDX identifier where one exists.

id.description: Stable identifier that substances refer to.

substanceGroup.description: A named group of substances, such as a pharmacological class. Interactions can target a group as a whole, and substances in the same cross tolerance group share tolerance.

id.description: Stable identifier that the rest of the document refers to.

members.description: Canonical names of the catalog substances in the group. May be empty when no catalog substance belongs to it.

name.description: Canonical name, unique in the catalog. Ingestions store this name.

aliases.description: Other names the substance is known by. May be empty.

url.description: PsychonautWiki article of the substance: https only, printable ASCII (anything else percent-encoded).

categories.description: Identifiers of the categories the substance belongs to.

classes.description: Classes PsychonautWiki assigns to the substance.

roas.description: Routes of administration with their dose and duration data.

tolerance.description: How tolerance builds up and fades. Absent when nothing is known.

crossTolerances.description: Identifiers of the entries of crossToleranceGroups the substance has cross tolerance with. May be empty.

addictionPotential.description: Free text describing the addiction potential.

toxicities.description: Free text statements about toxicity. May be empty.

effectsSummary.description: Free text, possibly several paragraphs, overview of the effects.

dosageRemark.description: Free text, possibly several paragraphs, remark about dosing.

generalRisks.description: Free text, possibly several paragraphs, about the general risks.

longtermRisks.description: Free text, possibly several paragraphs, about the long-term risks.

saferUse.description: Safer use advice, one item per piece of advice. Absent when there is none.

classes.description: Psychoactive and chemical classes of a substance.

psychoactive.description: Psychoactive classes, for example Psychedelics. May be empty.

chemical.description: Chemical classes, for example Lysergamides. May be empty.

tolerance.description: Tolerance timeline. At least one of the three is present.

full.description: When full tolerance is reached, in the wording of the wiki.

half.description: Time until tolerance falls to half.

zero.description: Time until tolerance returns to baseline.

toleranceTime.description: A time in the tolerance timeline: the wording of the wiki and, when it can be read as a time, the same as a range in minutes. The app draws from the numbers and never parses the text. For example "5 days" is 7200 and 7200, and "1-2 weeks" is 10080 and 20160.

min.description: Lower bound in minutes. Present exactly when max is.

max.description: Upper bound in minutes. Present exactly when min is.

kind.description: substance: name is a canonical substance name. group: name is the name of an entry in interactionGroups. other: name is a drug or thing outside the catalog, kept as text.

name.description: Name of the target, interpreted according to kind.

roa.description: One route of administration of a substance.

dose.description: Dose boundaries for this route. Absent when nothing is known, not even the units.

duration.description: Duration of each phase for this route. Absent when unknown.

bioavailability.description: Bioavailability for this route. Absent when unknown.

dose.description: Dose boundaries for one route, in the given units. A dose below lightMin is a threshold dose; from lightMin up to, but not including, commonMin it is light; from commonMin up to strongMin it is common; from strongMin up to heavyMin it is strong; from heavyMin up it is heavy. A missing boundary means the two classes it would separate cannot be told apart. A dose with units and no boundary only says which unit the wiki uses.

units.description: Units of every boundary, as text. Exactly three spellings are mass units that the app may convert between: µg (with the micro sign U+00B5), mg and g. Every other value is opaque and is never converted. The Greek letter mu (U+03BC) is rejected, so micrograms have one spelling.

lightMin.description: Lowest light dose. Below it a dose is a threshold dose.

duration.description: Duration of each phase, in minutes. At least one phase is present.

comeup.description: Time from the first effects to the peak.

offset.description: Time the effects take to fade after the peak.

durationRange.description: A duration range in minutes. Each bound is optional, at least one is present.

bioavailability.description: Bioavailability in percent. Each bound is optional, at least one is present.
